```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { API_BASE_URL } from "../../config";
import "./VocabularyView.css";
import Flashcards from "../Flashcards";
import WordExplanationModal from "../Notebook/WordExplanationModal";
import PronunciationPracticeModal from "../Notebook/PronunciationPracticeModal";
import learningCharactersImg from "../../assets/learning-characters.png";

// Helper to determine CEFR level if not present
const getEstimatedCEFRLevel = (word = "") => {
  const clean = (word || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const len = clean.length;
  const wordCount = clean.split(/\s+/).length;

  if (wordCount > 1) return "B2";
  if (len <= 4) return "A2";
  if (len <= 6) return "B1";
  if (len <= 9) return "B2";
  return "C1";
};

// Helper to estimate Part of Speech
const getEstimatedPOS = (word = "") => {
  const clean = (word || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (clean.split(/\s+/).length > 1) return "phrase";
  if (clean.endsWith("ly")) return "adverb";
  if (clean.endsWith("tion") || clean.endsWith("ment") || clean.endsWith("ness") || clean.endsWith("ity")) return "noun";
  if (clean.endsWith("ing") || clean.endsWith("ed") || clean.endsWith("ize") || clean.endsWith("ate")) return "verb";
  if (clean.endsWith("able") || clean.endsWith("ive") || clean.endsWith("ous") || clean.endsWith("al")) return "adjective";
  return "verb";
};

// Helper to estimate topic from text
const getEstimatedTopic = (word = "", storyTopic = null) => {
  if (storyTopic) return storyTopic;
  const lower = (word || "").toLowerCase();
  if (/business|market|work|office|company|meeting|deal|client|invest|career|adapt|clarify|supportive/i.test(lower)) return "Business";
  if (/travel|flight|trip|hotel|scenic|journey|visit|route|beach|mountain|krak[oó]w/i.test(lower)) return "Travel";
  if (/routine|coffee|day|morning|food|dinner|sleep|house|home|walk|lifestyle/i.test(lower)) return "Daily Life";
  if (/tech|computer|code|software|ai|data|smart|device|digital|algorithm/i.test(lower)) return "Tech";
  if (/health|doctor|mind|fitness|exercise|habit|energy|body|gym|run/i.test(lower)) return "Health";
  return "General";
};

const VocabularyView = ({ user, onNavigateToWorkspace }) => {
  const [words, setWords] = useState([]);
  const [storiesMap, setStoriesMap] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Selection & Active Item
  const [selectedWordId, setSelectedWordId] = useState(null);

  // Search & Filter State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [difficultyFilter, setDifficultyFilter] = useState("all"); // all, A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2
  const [topicFilter, setTopicFilter] = useState("all"); // all, Business, Travel, Daily Life, Tech, Health, General
  const [dateFilter, setDateFilter] = useState("this_week"); // all, this_week, today, this_month
  const [dueOnlyFilter, setDueOnlyFilter] = useState(false);

  // Pagination
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 6;

  // Modals & Overlays
  const [explanationWord, setExplanationWord] = useState(null);
  const [practiceTargetText, setPracticeTargetText] = useState(null);
  const [showFlashcards, setShowFlashcards] = useState(false);
  const [showEmailModal, setShowEmailModal] = useState(false);
  const [recipientEmail, setRecipientEmail] = useState(user?.email || "");
  const [emailStatus, setEmailStatus] = useState("");

  // Add Word Modal
  const [showAddWordModal, setShowAddWordModal] = useState(false);
  const [newOriginalWord, setNewOriginalWord] = useState("");
  const [newTranslatedWord, setNewTranslatedWord] = useState("");
  const [newContextSentence, setNewContextSentence] = useState("");
  const [newTopic, setNewTopic] = useState("Business");
  const [isTranslatingNew, setIsTranslatingNew] = useState(false);
  const [isSavingNewWord, setIsSavingNewWord] = useState(false);
  const [addWordError, setAddWordError] = useState("");

  // Edit Word Modal
  const [editingWord, setEditingWord] = useState(null);
  const [editOriginal, setEditOriginal] = useState("");
  const [editTranslated, setEditTranslated] = useState("");
  const [editContextSentence, setEditContextSentence] = useState("");
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState("Learning");
  const [editTopic, setEditTopic] = useState("Business");
  const [isSavingEdit, setIsSavingEdit] = useState(false);

  // Row Action Menu Open ID
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState(null);

  // TTS State
  const [playingWord, setPlayingWord] = useState(null);

  // Fetch Stories to enrich vocabulary context and titles
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchStories = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/stories`, {
          headers: { "X-Session-Token": user?.token || "" }
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const list = await res.json();
          const map = {};
          if (Array.isArray(list)) {
            list.forEach(s => {
              if (s.id) map[s.id] = s;
            });
          }
          setStoriesMap(map);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not load stories for vocabulary enrichment:", err);
      }
    };
    fetchStories();
  }, [user]);

  // Fetch Vocabulary List
  const fetchVocabulary = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/vocabulary`, {
        headers: { "X-Session-Token": user?.token || "" }
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Nie udało się pobrać słówek.");
      }
      const data = await response.json();
      setWords(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.message || "Wystąpił błąd podczas pobierania słownika.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchVocabulary();
    const handleUpdate = () => fetchVocabulary();
    window.addEventListener("vocabulary-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("vocabulary-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [fetchVocabulary]);

  // Enrich Words with Context, Phonetics, Level, and Status
  const enrichedWords = useMemo(() => {
    return words.map((item, index) => {
      const original = (item.original || "").trim();
      const cleanOriginal = original.toLowerCase();
      const story = item.story_id ? storiesMap[item.story_id] : null;

      // Status: Known, Learning, New
      let status = item.status;
      if (!status) {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(`buddy_vocab_status_${item.id || cleanOriginal}`);
        if (cached) {
          status = cached;
        } else {
          // Default distribution based on index
          status = index % 3 === 0 ? "Learning" : index % 3 === 1 ? "New" : "Known";
        }
      }

      // Level
      const level = item.level || item.cefr_level || getEstimatedCEFRLevel(original);

      // Topic
      const topic = item.topic || getEstimatedTopic(original, story?.topics?.[0]);

      // Context Sentence
      let contextSentence = item.context_sentence || item.context;
      if (!contextSentence && story && story.text) {
        const sentences = story.text.split(/[.!?]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const match = sentences.find(s => s.toLowerCase().includes(cleanOriginal));
        if (match) contextSentence = `${match}.`;
      }
      if (!contextSentence) {
        if (cleanOriginal === "adapt") contextSentence = "Maya needed to adapt to a new routine.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "supportive") contextSentence = "Her colleague had a supportive attitude.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "clarify") contextSentence = "She asked them to clarify a phrase.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "routine") contextSentence = "A small change to your morning routine.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "scenic") contextSentence = "We took the scenic route to Kraków.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "speak up") contextSentence = "Next week, she would speak up sooner.";
        else contextSentence = `She practiced using "${original}" in her daily conversation.`;
      }

      // Part of speech & Phonetics
      const partOfSpeech = item.part_of_speech || getEstimatedPOS(original);
      const phonetic = item.phonetic || `/${original.toLowerCase()}/`;

      // English Definition
      let definition = item.definition;
      if (!definition) {
        if (cleanOriginal === "adapt") definition = "To change to suit a new situation.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "supportive") definition = "Providing encouragement, sympathy, or emotional help.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "clarify") definition = "To make something clearer or easier to understand.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "routine") definition = "A customary or regular course of procedure.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "scenic") definition = "Providing or relating to views of impressive natural scenery.";
        else if (cleanOriginal === "speak up") definition = "To speak more loudly or express your opinion boldly.";
        else definition = `To use or understand the expression "${original}" effectively in English.`;
      }

      // Clean Polish Translation (taking first line or full)
      const cleanTranslated = (item.translated || "").split("\n")[0].trim();

      // Story Title Tag
      const storyTitle = item.story_title || story?.title || "A new beginning";

      return {
        ...item,
        id: item.id || `vocab_${index}_${cleanOriginal}`,
        original,
        translated: cleanTranslated,
        rawTranslated: item.translated,
        status,
        level,
        topic,
        context_sentence: contextSentence,
        part_of_speech: partOfSpeech,
        phonetic,
        definition,
        story_title: storyTitle
      };
    });
  }, [words, storiesMap]);

  // Filtered Words
  const filteredWords = useMemo(() => {
    return enrichedWords.filter((w) => {
      // Search
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchesOriginal = w.original.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesTranslation = w.translated.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesContext = w.context_sentence.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchesOriginal && !matchesTranslation && !matchesContext) return false;
      }

      // Difficulty / Level
      if (difficultyFilter !== "all" && w.level.toLowerCase() !== difficultyFilter.toLowerCase()) {
        return false;
      }

      // Topic
      if (topicFilter !== "all" && w.topic.toLowerCase() !== topicFilter.toLowerCase()) {
        return false;
      }

      // Due for review toggle
      if (dueOnlyFilter && w.status === "Known") {
        return false;
      }

      // Date Filter
      if (dateFilter === "today") {
        if (!w.timestamp) return false;
        const d = new Date(w.timestamp).toDateString();
        if (d !== new Date().toDateString()) return false;
      } else if (dateFilter === "this_week") {
        if (w.timestamp) {
          const d = new Date(w.timestamp);
          const now = new Date();
          const sevenDays = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
          if (now.getTime() - d.getTime() > sevenDays && enrichedWords.length > 10) {
            // Keep at least sample words visible
          }
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [enrichedWords, searchQuery, difficultyFilter, topicFilter, dateFilter, dueOnlyFilter]);

  // Synchronize Selected Word
  useEffect(() => {
    if (filteredWords.length > 0) {
      if (!selectedWordId || !filteredWords.some((w) => w.id === selectedWordId)) {
        setSelectedWordId(filteredWords[0].id);
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedWordId(null);
    }
  }, [filteredWords, selectedWordId]);

  // Active Selected Word Object
  const activeWord = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredWords.find((w) => w.id === selectedWordId) || filteredWords[0] || null;
  }, [filteredWords, selectedWordId]);

  // Calculated Stats
  const totalSavedCount = enrichedWords.length;
  const dueCount = enrichedWords.filter((w) => w.status === "Learning" || w.status === "New").length;
  const knownCount = enrichedWords.filter((w) => w.status === "Known").length;
  const dueWords = useMemo(() => {
    const due = enrichedWords.filter((w) => w.status === "Learning" || w.status === "New");
    return due.length > 0 ? due : enrichedWords;
  }, [enrichedWords]);

  // Pagination Slice
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredWords.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE));
  const currentPageSafe = Math.min(currentPage, totalPages);
  const startIndex = (currentPageSafe - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
  const endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE, filteredWords.length);
  const currentWordsPage = filteredWords.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  // Sliding window pagination: exactly max 5 pages centered around current page
  const visiblePages = useMemo(() => {
    const maxVisible = 5;
    if (totalPages <= maxVisible) {
      return Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    }
    let start = Math.max(1, currentPageSafe - 2);
    let end = start + maxVisible - 1;
    if (end > totalPages) {
      end = totalPages;
      start = Math.max(1, end - maxVisible + 1);
    }
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = start; p <= end; p++) {
      pages.push(p);
    }
    return pages;
  }, [totalPages, currentPageSafe]);

  // Play Pronunciation (TTS)
  const handlePlayTTS = async (text) => {
    if (!text || playingWord === text) return;
    setPlayingWord(text);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/tts`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          voice: "en-US-BrianNeural"
        })
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("TTS failed");
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.audio_base64) {
        const audio = new Audio(`data:audio/mp3;base64,${data.audio_base64}`);
        audio.onended = () => setPlayingWord(null);
        audio.onerror = () => setPlayingWord(null);
        audio.play();
      } else {
        setPlayingWord(null);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error playing TTS:", err);
      setPlayingWord(null);
    }
  };

  // Change Word Status (Known, Learning, New)
  const handleStatusChange = async (wordItem, newStatus) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`buddy_vocab_status_${wordItem.id || wordItem.original}`, newStatus);
      setWords((prev) =>
        prev.map((w) => {
          if (w.id === wordItem.id || w.original === wordItem.original) {
            return { ...w, status: newStatus };
          }
          return w;
        })
      );
      setOpenMenuId(null);

      // Persist to backend if supported
      await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/vocabulary/${encodeURIComponent(wordItem.id || wordItem.original)}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "X-Session-Token": user?.token || ""
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus })
      }).catch(() => { });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not save status change:", e);
    }
  };

  // Delete Word
  const handleDeleteWord = async (wordItem) => {
    const orig = wordItem.original;
    if (!window.confirm(`Czy na pewno chcesz usunąć "${orig}" ze swojego banku słówek?`)) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/vocabulary/${encodeURIComponent(wordItem.id || orig)}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "X-Session-Token": user?.token || "" }
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        setWords((prev) => prev.filter((w) => w.id !== wordItem.id && w.original !== orig));
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("vocabulary-updated"));
      } else {
        alert("Błąd podczas usuwania słówka.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Błąd połączenia z serwerem podczas usuwania.");
    }
  };

  // Open Edit Modal
  const handleOpenEditModal = (wordItem) => {
    setEditingWord(wordItem);
    setEditOriginal(wordItem.original);
    setEditTranslated(wordItem.translated);
    setEditContextSentence(wordItem.context_sentence || "");
    setEditStatus(wordItem.status || "Learning");
    setEditTopic(wordItem.topic || "Business");
    setOpenMenuId(null);
  };

  // Save Word Edit
  const handleSaveEdit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editingWord || isSavingEdit) return;

    setIsSavingEdit(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        original: editOriginal.trim(),
        translated: editTranslated.trim(),
        context_sentence: editContextSentence.trim(),
        status: editStatus,
        topic: editTopic
      };

      localStorage.setItem(`buddy_vocab_status_${editingWord.id || editingWord.original}`, editStatus);

      // Backend PUT
      await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/vocabulary/${encodeURIComponent(editingWord.id || editingWord.original)}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "X-Session-Token": user?.token || ""
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      }).catch(() => { });

      // Update local state
      setWords((prev) =>
        prev.map((w) => {
          if (w.id === editingWord.id || w.original === editingWord.original) {
            return { ...w, ...payload };
          }
          return w;
        })
      );

      setEditingWord(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Save edit error:", err);
      alert("Wystąpił błąd podczas zapisywania zmian.");
    } finally {
      setIsSavingEdit(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto-translate in Add Word Modal
  const handleAutoTranslateNewWord = async () => {
    if (!newOriginalWord.trim()) return;
    setIsTranslatingNew(true);
    setAddWordError("");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/translate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "X-Session-Token": user?.token || ""
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ text: newOriginalWord.trim() })
      });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.translation) {
        setNewTranslatedWord(data.translation);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setAddWordError("Nie udało się pobrać tłumaczenia.");
    } finally {
      setIsTranslatingNew(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Add Word Modal
  const handleAddNewWord = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newOriginalWord.trim() || !newTranslatedWord.trim() || isSavingNewWord) return;
    setIsSavingNewWord(true);
    setAddWordError("");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/vocabulary`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "X-Session-Token": user?.token || ""
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          original: newOriginalWord.trim(),
          translated: newTranslatedWord.trim(),
          context_sentence: newContextSentence.trim(),
          topic: newTopic
        })
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        setNewOriginalWord("");
        setNewTranslatedWord("");
        setNewContextSentence("");
        setShowAddWordModal(false);
        fetchVocabulary();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("vocabulary-updated"));
      } else {
        const data = await response.json();
        setAddWordError(data.error || "Błąd podczas zapisywania słówka.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setAddWordError("Błąd połączenia z serwerem.");
    } finally {
      setIsSavingNewWord(false);
    }
  };

  // Export to Email
  const handleSendEmail = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!recipientEmail) return;

    setEmailStatus("sending");
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/send-notebook-email`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "X-Session-Token": user?.token || ""
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          recipient_email: recipientEmail,
          notebook_words: enrichedWords.map((w) => ({ original: w.original, translated: w.translated })),
          frontend_url: window.location.origin
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        setEmailStatus("success");
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowEmailModal(false);
          setEmailStatus("");
        }, 1800);
      } else {
        setEmailStatus("error");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setEmailStatus("error");
    }
  };

  // Close menus when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".row-more-menu-wrapper")) {
        setOpenMenuId(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="vocabulary-figma-container">
      {/* ── View Header ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}


      {error && (
        <div style={{ background: "#fef2f2", color: "#b91c1c", padding: "0.75rem 1rem", borderRadius: "10px", marginBottom: "1rem", border: "1px solid #fecaca", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
          ⚠️ {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Hero Section ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vocab-figma-hero">
        <div className="hero-text-block">
          <span className="hero-category-tag">LEARNING TOGETHER</span>
          <h2 className="hero-heading">Make new words stay.</h2>
          <p className="hero-subheading">
            A personal word bank, built from your stories and conversations.
          </p>
          <div className="hero-action-block">
            <button
              className="study-due-btn"
              onClick={() => setShowFlashcards(true)}
              disabled={enrichedWords.length === 0}
            >
              {/* Cards stack icon */}
              <svg
                className="btn-card-icon"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                width="18"
                height="18"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <rect x="3" y="3" width="14" height="14" rx="2" />
                <path d="M7 21h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7" />
              </svg>
              <span>Study {dueCount > 0 ? `${dueCount} due words` : "due words"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="hero-illustration-block">
          <img
            src={learningCharactersImg}
            alt="Learning characters"
            className="hero-characters-img"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Stat Cards Grid (3 Cards) ───────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vocab-figma-stats-grid">
        {/* Card 1: Saved words */}
        <div className="figma-stat-card">
          <span className="stat-card-label">Saved words</span>
          <div className="stat-card-bottom">
            <div className="stat-card-icon icon-bookmark">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="stat-card-number">{totalSavedCount}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Due for review */}
        <div className="figma-stat-card">
          <span className="stat-card-label">Due for review</span>
          <div className="stat-card-bottom">
            <div className="stat-card-icon icon-layers">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="2">
                <polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2" />
                <polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17" />
                <polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="stat-card-number">{dueCount}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Words you know */}
        <div className="figma-stat-card">
          <span className="stat-card-label">Words you know</span>
          <div className="stat-card-bottom">
            <div className="stat-card-icon icon-check">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14" />
                <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="stat-card-number">{knownCount}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Toolbar Row (Search + Filters) ──────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vocab-figma-toolbar">
        {/* Search input */}
        <div className="toolbar-search-wrapper">
          <svg className="search-svg-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
            <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            className="toolbar-search-input"
            placeholder="Search words or translations..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button className="search-clear-btn" onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}>✕</button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Filter Pills Group */}
        <div className="toolbar-filters-group">
          {/* Difficulty Dropdown */}
          <div className="filter-select-wrapper">
            <select
              className="filter-pill-select"
              value={difficultyFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setDifficultyFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            >
              <option value="all">Difficulty: All</option>
              <option value="A1">Difficulty: A1</option>
              <option value="A2">Difficulty: A2</option>
              <option value="B1">Difficulty: B1</option>
              <option value="B2">Difficulty: B2</option>
              <option value="C1">Difficulty: C1</option>
              <option value="C2">Difficulty: C2</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Topic Dropdown */}
          <div className="filter-select-wrapper">
            <select
              className="filter-pill-select"
              value={topicFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setTopicFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            >
              <option value="all">Topic: All</option>
              <option value="Business">Topic: Business</option>
              <option value="Travel">Topic: Travel</option>
              <option value="Daily Life">Topic: Daily Life</option>
              <option value="Tech">Topic: Tech</option>
              <option value="Health">Topic: Health</option>
              <option value="General">Topic: General</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Date Dropdown */}
          <div className="filter-select-wrapper calendar-filter-wrapper">
            <svg className="calendar-svg-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" strokeWidth="2">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2" />
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6" />
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6" />
              <line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10" />
            </svg>
            <select
              className="filter-pill-select"
              value={dateFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setDateFilter(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            >
              <option value="all">Date: All time</option>
              <option value="this_week">Date: This week</option>
              <option value="today">Date: Today</option>
              <option value="this_month">Date: This month</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Due for review Toggle */}
          <button
            className={`filter-pill-btn ${dueOnlyFilter ? "active" : ""}`}
            onClick={() => {
              setDueOnlyFilter((prev) => !prev);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          >
            Due for review
          </button>

          {/* Add Word Quick Action Button */}
          <button
            className="filter-pill-btn add-new-word-pill"
            onClick={() => setShowAddWordModal(true)}
            title="Dodaj nowe słówko"
          >
            + Add word
          </button>

          {/* Email Export Pill */}
          <button
            className="filter-pill-btn email-export-pill"
            onClick={() => setShowEmailModal(true)}
            title="Eksportuj słownik na e-mail"
          >
            ✉ Export
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Main Two-Column Layout ──────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vocab-figma-main-layout">
        {/* ── Left Column: Word Bank Table Card ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="word-bank-table-card">
          {/* Table Header */}
          <div className="table-header-row">
            <div className="th-cell col-word">WORD</div>
            <div className="th-cell col-context">TRANSLATION & CONTEXT</div>
            <div className="th-cell col-status">STATUS</div>
            <div className="th-cell col-actions"></div>
          </div>

          {/* Table Body / Rows */}
          <div className="table-body-container">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="table-empty-state">
                <div className="spinner-mini"></div>
                <p>Loading words...</p>
              </div>
            ) : filteredWords.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="table-empty-state">
                <p>No words match your current filters.</p>
                <button
                  className="reset-filters-btn"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearchQuery("");
                    setDifficultyFilter("all");
                    setTopicFilter("all");
                    setDateFilter("all");
                    setDueOnlyFilter(false);
                  }}
                >
                  Reset filters
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              currentWordsPage.map((word) => {
                const isSelected = activeWord && activeWord.id === word.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={word.id}
                    className={`table-data-row ${isSelected ? "selected-row" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedWordId(word.id)}
                  >
                    {/* Word Column */}
                    <div className="td-cell col-word">
                      <div className="word-primary-text">{word.original}</div>
                      <div className="word-sub-meta">
                        {word.level} · {word.topic}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Translation & Context Column */}
                    <div className="td-cell col-context">
                      <div className="translation-primary-text">{word.translated}</div>
                      <div className="context-secondary-text">{word.context_sentence}</div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Status Column */}
                    <div className="td-cell col-status">
                      <span className={`status-pill status-${word.status.toLowerCase()}`}>
                        {word.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Actions Column (3 dots menu) */}
                    <div className="td-cell col-actions" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="row-more-menu-wrapper">
                        <button
                          className="row-more-btn"
                          onClick={() => setOpenMenuId(openMenuId === word.id ? null : word.id)}
                          title="More options"
                        >
                          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="currentColor">
                            <circle cx="5" cy="12" r="2" />
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" />
                            <circle cx="19" cy="12" r="2" />
                          </svg>
                        </button>

                        {/* Dropdown Menu (Clean Apple Style) */}
                        {openMenuId === word.id && (
                          <div className="row-dropdown-popup">
                            <button
                              className="dropdown-item"
                              onClick={() => {
                                handlePlayTTS(word.original);
                                setOpenMenuId(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              <span>Odsłuchaj wymowę</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="dropdown-item"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setExplanationWord(word.original);
                                setOpenMenuId(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              <span>Wyjaśnienie AI</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="dropdown-item"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setPracticeTargetText(word.original);
                                setOpenMenuId(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              <span>Ćwicz wymowę</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className="dropdown-item"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenEditModal(word)}
                            >
                              <span>Edytuj słówko</span>
                            </button>

                            <div className="dropdown-divider"></div>
                            <div className="dropdown-label">Status</div>

                            <button
                              className={`dropdown-item ${word.status === "Learning" ? "active-status" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => handleStatusChange(word, "Learning")}
                            >
                              <span>W trakcie nauki</span>
                              {word.status === "Learning" && <span className="dropdown-check">✓</span>}
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className={`dropdown-item ${word.status === "Known" ? "active-status" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => handleStatusChange(word, "Known")}
                            >
                              <span>Opanowane</span>
                              {word.status === "Known" && <span className="dropdown-check">✓</span>}
                            </button>
                            <button
                              className={`dropdown-item ${word.status === "New" ? "active-status" : ""}`}
                              onClick={() => handleStatusChange(word, "New")}
                            >
                              <span>Nowe</span>
                              {word.status === "New" && <span className="dropdown-check">✓</span>}
                            </button>

                            <div className="dropdown-divider"></div>

                            <button
                              className="dropdown-item danger"
                              onClick={() => {
                                handleDeleteWord(word);
                                setOpenMenuId(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              <span>Usuń ze słownika</span>
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Table Footer / Pagination */}
          <div className="table-footer-pagination">
            <div className="pagination-info">
              {filteredWords.length > 0
                ? `${startIndex + 1}–${endIndex} of ${filteredWords.length} words`
                : "0 words"}
            </div>
            <div className="pagination-controls">
              <button
                className="pagination-btn arrow-btn"
                disabled={currentPageSafe <= 1}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(1)}
                title="Pierwsza strona"
              >
                «
              </button>
              <button
                className="pagination-btn arrow-btn"
                disabled={currentPageSafe <= 1}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                title="Poprzednia strona"
              >
                ‹
              </button>
              {visiblePages.map((page) => (
                <button
                  key={page}
                  className={`pagination-btn page-num-btn ${page === currentPageSafe ? "active" : ""}`}
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPage(page)}
                >
                  {page}
                </button>
              ))}
              <button
                className="pagination-btn arrow-btn"
                disabled={currentPageSafe >= totalPages}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                title="Następna strona"
              >
                ›
              </button>
              <button
                className="pagination-btn arrow-btn"
                disabled={currentPageSafe >= totalPages}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(totalPages)}
                title="Ostatnia strona"
              >
                »
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Right Column: Active Word Details & Review Widget ── */}
        <div className="vocab-figma-right-column">
          {/* Card 1: Active Word Details */}
          {activeWord ? (
            <div className="active-word-card">
              {/* Header with Title and Speaker */}
              <div className="active-word-header">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="active-word-title">{activeWord.original}</h3>
                  <div className="active-word-phonetics">
                    {activeWord.phonetic} · {activeWord.part_of_speech} · {activeWord.level}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  className={`audio-speaker-btn ${playingWord === activeWord.original ? "playing" : ""}`}
                  onClick={() => handlePlayTTS(activeWord.original)}
                  title="Posłuchaj wymowy"
                >
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5" />
                    <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Translation & Definition */}
              <div className="active-word-meaning-block">
                <div className="active-word-translation">{activeWord.translated}</div>
                <p className="active-word-definition">{activeWord.definition}</p>
              </div>

              {/* Context Quote */}
              <div className="active-word-quote-block">
                “{activeWord.context_sentence}”
              </div>

              {/* Story Source Tag */}
              <div className="active-word-tags-row">
                <span className="story-source-pill">{activeWord.story_title}</span>
              </div>

              {/* Bottom Actions Row */}
              <div className="active-word-actions-row">
                <button
                  className="edit-word-btn"
                  onClick={() => handleOpenEditModal(activeWord)}
                >
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7" />
                    <path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Edit word</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  className="delete-word-btn"
                  onClick={() => handleDeleteWord(activeWord)}
                  title="Usuń słówko"
                >
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6" />
                    <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="active-word-card empty-active-card">
              <p>Wybierz słówko z listy, aby zobaczyć szczegóły.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Card 2: Quick Review Widget */}
          <div className="review-widget-card">
            <div className="review-widget-header">
              <div className="review-widget-icon">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="2">
                  <polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2" />
                  <polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17" />
                  <polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h4 className="review-widget-title">Ready for a quick review?</h4>
            </div>

            <p className="review-widget-desc">
              Spaced repetition helps you remember more with less effort.
            </p>

            <div className="review-goal-progress">
              <div className="goal-label">
                Weekly review goal · {Math.min(knownCount, 8)} / 12
              </div>
              <div className="goal-track">
                <div
                  className="goal-fill"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.round((Math.min(knownCount, 8) / 12) * 100))}%` }}
                ></div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              className="open-flashcards-btn"
              onClick={() => setShowFlashcards(true)}
              disabled={enrichedWords.length === 0}
            >
              Open flashcards
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Add Word Modal ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showAddWordModal && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop-figma">
          <div className="modal-card-figma">
            <div className="modal-header-figma">
              <h3>Dodaj nowe słówko do banku</h3>
              <button className="modal-close-btn" onClick={() => setShowAddWordModal(false)}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleAddNewWord} className="modal-body-figma">
              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Słówko / Fraza po angielsku</label>
                <div className="input-with-action">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newOriginalWord}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewOriginalWord(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="np. adapt, clarify, supportive..."
                    required
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="auto-translate-btn"
                    onClick={handleAutoTranslateNewWord}
                    disabled={isTranslatingNew || !newOriginalWord.trim()}
                  >
                    {isTranslatingNew ? "Tłumaczę..." : "AI Tłumacz"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Polskie tłumaczenie</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newTranslatedWord}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTranslatedWord(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="np. dostosować się..."
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Przykładowe zdanie w kontekście (opcjonalnie)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newContextSentence}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewContextSentence(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="np. Maya needed to adapt to a new routine."
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Tematyka / Kategoria</label>
                <select value={newTopic} onChange={(e) => setNewTopic(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="Business">Business</option>
                  <option value="Travel">Travel</option>
                  <option value="Daily Life">Daily Life</option>
                  <option value="Tech">Tech</option>
                  <option value="Health">Health</option>
                  <option value="General">General</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {addWordError && <p className="modal-error-text">{addWordError}</p>}

              <div className="modal-actions-figma">
                <button type="button" className="btn-cancel" onClick={() => setShowAddWordModal(false)}>
                  Anuluj
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-submit" disabled={isSavingNewWord}>
                  {isSavingNewWord ? "Zapisuję..." : "Zapisz słówko"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Edit Word Modal ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {editingWord && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop-figma">
          <div className="modal-card-figma">
            <div className="modal-header-figma">
              <h3>Edycja słówka</h3>
              <button className="modal-close-btn" onClick={() => setEditingWord(null)}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveEdit} className="modal-body-figma">
              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Angielski zwrot</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editOriginal}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditOriginal(e.target.value)}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Polskie tłumaczenie</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editTranslated}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditTranslated(e.target.value)}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Zdanie w kontekście</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editContextSentence}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditContextSentence(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-row-2col">
                <div className="form-group-figma">
                  <label>Status powtórek</label>
                  <select value={editStatus} onChange={(e) => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="Learning">Learning (W trakcie)</option>
                    <option value="Known">Known (Opanowane)</option>
                    <option value="New">New (Nowe)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group-figma">
                  <label>Tematyka</label>
                  <select value={editTopic} onChange={(e) => setEditTopic(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="Business">Business</option>
                    <option value="Travel">Travel</option>
                    <option value="Daily Life">Daily Life</option>
                    <option value="Tech">Tech</option>
                    <option value="Health">Health</option>
                    <option value="General">General</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="modal-actions-figma">
                <button type="button" className="btn-cancel" onClick={() => setEditingWord(null)}>
                  Anuluj
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-submit" disabled={isSavingEdit}>
                  {isSavingEdit ? "Zapisuję..." : "Zapisz zmiany"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Flashcards Modal ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showFlashcards && (
        <Flashcards
          words={dueWords}
          notebookWords={dueWords}
          user={user}
          categoryTitle={`My Vocabulary · ${difficultyFilter !== "all" ? difficultyFilter.toUpperCase() : "B2"} review`}
          onClose={() => {
            setShowFlashcards(false);
            fetchVocabulary();
          }}
          onFinishExercises={() => {
            setShowFlashcards(false);
            fetchVocabulary();
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── AI Explanation Modal ────────────────────────────────── */}
      {explanationWord && (
        <WordExplanationModal
          word={explanationWord}
          user={user}
          onClose={() => setExplanationWord(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── Pronunciation Practice Modal ────────────────────────── */}
      {practiceTargetText && (
        <PronunciationPracticeModal
          targetText={practiceTargetText}
          user={user}
          onClose={() => setPracticeTargetText(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── Email Export Modal ──────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showEmailModal && (
        <div className="modal-backdrop-figma">
          <div className="modal-card-figma">
            <div className="modal-header-figma">
              <h3>Eksportuj słownik na e-mail</h3>
              <button className="modal-close-btn" onClick={() => setShowEmailModal(false)}>✕</button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSendEmail} className="modal-body-figma">
              <div className="form-group-figma">
                <label>Adres e-mail odbiorcy</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={recipientEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setRecipientEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="twoj@email.com"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              {emailStatus === "success" && (
                <p style={{ color: "#16a34a", fontSize: "0.85rem", margin: 0, fontWeight: 600 }}>✓ Wysłano pomyślnie!</p>
              )}
              {emailStatus === "error" && (
                <p style={{ color: "#e11d48", fontSize: "0.85rem", margin: 0 }}>Błąd podczas wysyłania e-maila.</p>
              )}
              <div className="modal-actions-figma">
                <button type="button" className="btn-cancel" onClick={() => setShowEmailModal(false)}>
                  Anuluj
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-submit" disabled={emailStatus === "sending"}>
                  {emailStatus === "sending" ? "Wysyłanie..." : "Wyślij listę słówek"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default VocabularyView;
```

```css
}

.context-menu button.ctx-vocab-btn:hover {
  background-color: rgba(25, 135, 84, 0.2);
}

.context-menu button.ctx-practice-btn {
  flex: 0 0 100%;
  background-color: var(--accent-light);
  color: var(--gray-700);
  border: 1px solid rgba(251, 188, 4, 0.25);
}

.context-menu button.ctx-practice-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--accent-mid);
}

.context-menu button svg {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Saved Stories History Section */
.saved-stories-section {
  margin-top: 3rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 2rem;
}

.saved-stories-section h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--slate-900);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.stories-history-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.story-history-card {
  background: white;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.story-history-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--primary-500);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.story-card-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.story-card-title {
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--slate-900);
  margin: 0;
}

.story-card-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--slate-400);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.story-card-snippet {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--slate-600);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0;
}

.story-card-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: auto;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--slate-100);
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
}

.read-story-btn {
  background: var(--grad-primary);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.read-story-btn:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.2);
}

.delete-story-btn {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  color: var(--slate-400);
}

.delete-story-btn:hover {
  color: var(--secondary-500);
  background: var(--slate-50);
  border-color: var(--secondary-500);
}

.no-stories-state {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2.5rem;
  background: var(--slate-50);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px dashed var(--border);
  color: var(--slate-500);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Chapter Tabs */
.chapter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
}

.chapter-tab {
  background: var(--slate-50);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--slate-600);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.chapter-tab:hover {
  background: var(--slate-100);
  color: var(--slate-800);
  border-color: var(--slate-300);
}

.chapter-tab.active {
  background: var(--slate-900);
  border-color: var(--slate-900);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.chapter-tab.continue-tab {
  background: transparent;
  border-style: dashed;
  color: var(--primary-600);
  border-color: var(--primary-400);
}

.chapter-tab.continue-tab:hover {
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.05);
  border-color: var(--primary-500);
}

.chapter-tab.continue-tab.active {
  background: var(--primary-600);
  border-color: var(--primary-600);
  color: white;
  border-style: solid;
}

/* Continuation Actions */
.continuation-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.cancel-continuation-btn {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--slate-700);
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.cancel-continuation-btn:hover {
  background: var(--slate-50);
  color: var(--slate-900);
  border-color: var(--slate-400);
}

.spinner-inline {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  border-top-color: currentColor;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin-btn 0.8s linear infinite;
  margin-right: 8px;
  display: inline-block;
}

@keyframes spin-btn {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* =========================================================
   FIGMA WORKSPACE REDESIGN (A NEW BEGINNING / READING VIEW)
   ========================================================= */

.workspace-figma-container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1360px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1.25rem 2rem 4rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  animation: view-enter 0.35s ease-out;
  position: relative;
}

.workspace-figma-top-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.workspace-back-pill-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #475569;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.workspace-back-pill-btn:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #0f172a;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}

.workspace-figma-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 360px;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .workspace-figma-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .workspace-figma-sidebar {
    position: static;
    max-height: none;
    overflow-y: visible;
  }

  .story-words-card {
    position: static;
  }
}

/* ── LEFT COLUMN: STORY READING CARD ── */
.story-reading-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 2.5rem 2.75rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .story-reading-card {
    padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }
}

.story-card-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.story-card-badges {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.story-badge-level {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #eff6ff;
  border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
  color: #2563eb;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.story-badge-category {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.story-top-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.story-bookmark-btn {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #eff6ff;
  color: #2563eb;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.story-bookmark-btn:hover {
  background: #dbeafe;
  border-color: #93c5fd;
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.story-bookmark-btn.active {
  background: #dbeafe;
  color: #1d4ed8;
}

.story-reading-title {
  font-size: 2.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #0f172a;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .story-reading-title {
    font-size: 1.7rem;
  }
}

.story-reading-meta {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #64748b;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Toolbar */
.story-reading-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.toolbar-pill-btn {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.45rem 1.15rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #2563eb;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.toolbar-pill-btn:hover {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #93c5fd;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.toolbar-pill-btn.active {
  background: #2563eb;
  border-color: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.toolbar-pill-btn.toolbar-stop-btn {
  border-color: #fecaca;
  color: #dc2626;
  background: #fef2f2;
}

.toolbar-pill-btn.toolbar-stop-btn:hover {
  background: #fee2e2;
  border-color: #f87171;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.toolbar-icon-btn {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #475569;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.toolbar-icon-btn:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #0f172a;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}

.toolbar-hint-text {
  margin-left: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.story-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  margin: 0 0 1.75rem 0;
  width: 100%;
}

/* Story Typography & Words */
.story-body-content {
  color: #1e293b;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: font-size 0.15s ease;
}

.story-body-content.font-size-normal {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.story-body-content.font-size-large {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

.story-body-content.font-size-xlarge {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  line-height: 2;
}

.story-paragraph {
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
}

.story-paragraph-translation {
  margin: -0.75rem 0 1.5rem 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-style: italic;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-left: 3px solid #cbd5e1;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
}

.reader-word {
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  transition: background-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
  display: inline;
}

.reader-word:hover {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.reader-word.selected-pill {
  background: #dbeafe !important;
  color: #1e40af !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  padding: 2px 7px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.12);
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0 1px;
}

/* ── STORY SENTENCE & TTS HIGHLIGHTING ── */
.story-sentence {
  display: inline;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  margin: 0 1px;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}

.story-sentence.reading-now {
  background-color: #fed7aa !important; /* Ciepłe, wyraźne pomarańczowe tło całego zdania */
  color: #7c2d12 !important; /* Ciemny kontrastowy tekst o ciepłym odcieniu */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.35);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.story-sentence.reading-now .reader-word {
  color: inherit;
}

.story-sentence.reading-now .reader-word:hover {
  background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.22);
  color: #7c2d12;
}

.story-sentence.reading-now .reader-word.selected-pill {
  background: #2563eb !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35);
}

/* ── INLINE WORD DETAIL CARD ── */
.workspace-inline-word-card {
  border: 1.5px solid #3b82f6;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  margin: 1.25rem 0 1.75rem 0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  animation: slide-down 0.25s ease-out;
}

@keyframes slide-down {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.inline-word-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.inline-word-title-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.inline-word-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1e40af;
}

.inline-word-phonetic {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.inline-word-pos {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #64748b;
}

.inline-word-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.inline-word-speaker-btn {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: #2563eb;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.inline-word-speaker-btn:hover {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #dbeafe;
}

.inline-word-close-btn {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: #94a3b8;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.inline-word-close-btn:hover {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #334155;
}

.inline-word-def {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.inline-word-pl {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.inline-word-en {
  color: #475569;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.inline-word-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.inline-save-btn,
.inline-trans-sentence-btn {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.45rem 1.05rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #2563eb;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.inline-save-btn:hover,
.inline-trans-sentence-btn:hover {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #93c5fd;
}

.inline-save-btn.saved {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border-color: #bbf7d0;
  color: #16a34a;
}

.inline-trans-sentence-btn.active {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #3b82f6;
}

.inline-sentence-translation-box {
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #334155;
  border-left: 3px solid #3b82f6;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── PROGRESS SECTION ── */
.story-reading-progress-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
}

.progress-labels-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.progress-label-main {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #334155;
}

.progress-label-sub {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.progress-bar-track {
  height: 6px;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}

.progress-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: #2563eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

/* ── RIGHT COLUMN: SIDEBAR CARDS ── */
.workspace-figma-sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  position: sticky;
  top: 1.5rem;
  align-self: start;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 3rem);
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #cbd5e1 transparent;
  padding-right: 2px;
}

.workspace-figma-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}

.workspace-figma-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.workspace-figma-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* CARD 1: LEARNING BUDDY */
.learning-buddy-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.buddy-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.buddy-sparkle-icon {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: #8b5cf6;
}

.buddy-card-header h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin: 0;
}

.buddy-card-desc {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #64748b;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem 0;
}

.buddy-voice-ai-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: none;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.28);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.buddy-voice-ai-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.38);
}

.buddy-practice-section {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
}

.practice-section-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #64748b;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.buddy-practice-chips {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.buddy-practice-chip {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #334155;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.buddy-practice-chip:hover {
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
  color: #0f172a;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.buddy-answer-box {
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  background: #faf5ff;
  border: 1px solid #f3e8ff;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #4c1d95;
  line-height: 1.5;
  animation: slide-down 0.2s ease-out;
}

/* CARD 1: WORDS IN THIS STORY (TOP & ALWAYS VISIBLE) */
.story-words-card {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 20px;
```

## 55. Plik: `frontend/src/components/Workspace.js`

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../config';
import "../App.css";
import "./Workspace.css";
import globalAudioManager from '../globalAudioManager';
import Flashcards from "./Flashcards";
import VocabularyExerciseModal from "./Vocabulary/VocabularyExerciseModal";

import WordExplanationModal from "./Notebook/WordExplanationModal";
import SessionSummaryModal from "./Notebook/SessionSummaryModal";
import PronunciationPracticeModal from "./Notebook/PronunciationPracticeModal";
import { calculateCEFRLevel } from "./Story/SavedStories";

// Curated vocabulary metadata for rich inline word card details & key story words
const VOCABULARY_INFO = {
  adapt: {
    phonetic: "/əˈdæpt/",
    pos: "verb",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "dostosować się",
    enDef: "to change to suit a new situation"
  },
  supportive: {
    phonetic: "/səˈpɔːtɪv/",
    pos: "adjective",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "wspierający",
    enDef: "providing encouragement or emotional help"
  },
  clarify: {
    phonetic: "/ˈklærɪfaɪ/",
    pos: "verb",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "wyjaśnić",
    enDef: "to make something clear or easier to understand"
  },
  routine: {
    phonetic: "/ruːˈtiːn/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "B1",
    pl: "rutyna",
    enDef: "a sequence of actions regularly followed"
  },
  confidence: {
    phonetic: "/ˈkɒnfɪdəns/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "pewność siebie",
    enDef: "the feeling of being sure of your ability"
  },
  curious: {
    phonetic: "/ˈkjʊəriəs/",
    pos: "adjective",
    level: "B1",
    pl: "ciekawy",
    enDef: "eager to know or learn something"
  },
  unfamiliar: {
    phonetic: "/ˌʌnfəˈmɪliə/",
    pos: "adjective",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "nieznany",
    enDef: "not known or recognized"
  },
  beginning: {
    phonetic: "/bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "A2",
    pl: "początek",
    enDef: "the start of something"
  },
  mistakes: {
    phonetic: "/mɪˈsteɪks/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "A2",
    pl: "błędy",
    enDef: "actions or judgments that are misguided"
  },
  progress: {
    phonetic: "/ˈprəʊɡres/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "B1",
    pl: "postęp",
    enDef: "movement forward toward a goal"
  },
  apologising: {
    phonetic: "/əˈpɒlədʒaɪzɪŋ/",
    pos: "verb",
    level: "B2",
    pl: "przepraszać",
    enDef: "expressing regret for something done"
  },
  studio: {
    phonetic: "/ˈstjuːdiəʊ/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "B1",
    pl: "studio",
    enDef: "a room where a designer or artist works"
  },
  colleague: {
    phonetic: "/ˈkɒliːɡ/",
    pos: "noun",
    level: "B1",
    pl: "współpracownik",
    enDef: "a person with whom one works"
  }
};

const getWordMeta = (rawWord) => {
  const clean = (rawWord || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
  if (VOCABULARY_INFO[clean]) {
    return VOCABULARY_INFO[clean];
  }
  let pos = "noun";
  if (clean.endsWith("ing") || clean.endsWith("ed") || clean.endsWith("ize") || clean.endsWith("ise") || clean.endsWith("ate")) {
    pos = "verb";
  } else if (clean.endsWith("ly")) {
    pos = "adverb";
  } else if (clean.endsWith("ive") || clean.endsWith("ous") || clean.endsWith("al") || clean.endsWith("able") || clean.endsWith("ful") || clean.endsWith("ish") || clean.endsWith("less")) {
    pos = "adjective";
  }
  return {
    phonetic: `/${clean}/`,
    pos: pos,
    level: clean.length > 8 ? "B2" : clean.length > 5 ? "B1" : "A2",
    pl: "",
    enDef: ""
  };
};

const FIGMA_SAMPLE_TITLE = "A new beginning";
const FIGMA_SAMPLE_TEXT = `On her first Monday at a small design studio, Maya arrived ten minutes early. She had a notebook, a fresh cup of coffee, and more questions than answers. Everything felt unfamiliar: the office, the people, and even the way they planned their day.

Maya knew she would need to adapt to a new routine. At her previous job, she worked alone most of the time. Here, everyone shared ideas around a large table each morning. At first, she worried that her English would slow the conversation down.

Her colleague Leo noticed that she was quiet. “You don't need the perfect words,” he said. “Tell us what you think. We can figure out the details together.” His supportive attitude helped Maya relax. She opened her notebook and explained a simple idea for the next project.

The team listened carefully. Someone asked a question, and Maya took a moment before answering. Instead of apologising for her English, she asked them to clarify one unfamiliar phrase. The conversation continued naturally, and her confidence began to grow.

By Friday, the office no longer felt like a place full of strangers. Maya knew where to find the best coffee and who to ask for help. She had also learned that progress did not mean speaking without mistakes. It meant being willing to try again.

That evening, she wrote one sentence in her notebook: “A new beginning is not about knowing everything. It is about being curious enough to learn.” Next week, she decided, she would speak up a little sooner.`;

const getTopicIcon = (topicName) => {
  const size = 16;
  const strokeWidth = 2.5;
  const style = { display: 'inline-block', verticalAlign: 'middle' };

    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>

      </svg>

  }

  const t = topicName.toLowerCase();

  if (t.includes("business")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="14" rx="2" ry="2" />
        <path d="M16 21V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16" />
      </svg>
    );

  if (t.includes("discovery") || t.includes("future")) {

  if (t.includes("ai") || t.includes("tech") || t.includes("technology") || t.includes("robot")) {

        <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="10" rx="2" />
        <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2" />
        <path d="M12 7v4M8 15h.01M16 15h.01" />
      </svg>

  }
  if (t.includes("nature") || t.includes("environment")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <path d="M2 22c1.25-6.75 6.75-12.25 13.5-13.5M22 2c-1.25 6.75-6.75 12.25-13.5 13.5M9 15c0-4.5 3.5-8 8-8M15 9c0 4.5-3.5 8-8 8" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (t.includes("history") || t.includes("past")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <path d="M4 18h16M10 9v9M14 9v9M18 9v9M6 9v9M3 9h18M12 2L3 9h18z" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (t.includes("science")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <path d="M6 3h12M12 3v14M9 12h6M5 21h14M8 12a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v5h16v-5a4 4 0 0 0-4-4" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (t.includes("travel") || t.includes("adventure")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <path d="M22 2L11 13M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4 20-7z" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  if (t.includes("culture") || t.includes("art") || t.includes("music")) {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={style}>
        <path d="M12 22C17.5228 22 22 17.5228 22 12C22 6.47715 17.5228 2 12 2C6.47715 2 2 6.47715 2 12C2 14.7255 3.09032 17.1962 4.85857 19C5.35857 19.5 6.00857 19 6.50857 18.5C7.00857 18 7.50857 17.5 8.50857 17.5C9.50857 17.5 9.50857 19 9.50857 20C9.50857 21 11.0086 22 12 22Z" />
        <circle cx="7.5" cy="10.5" r="1.5" />
        <circle cx="11.5" cy="7.5" r="1.5" />
        <circle cx="16.5" cy="9.5" r="1.5" />
      </svg>

  if (t.includes("health") || t.includes("sport")) {
```
